notes: Two routes split by «ح»: the first route as written ends at «أبو كثير» because its branch carries no saying; the saying «الخمر من هاتين» and «قال سمعت أبا هريرة» belong to the second route, which repeats the names of the first, so there is no shared tail; «وقال سويد في هاتين الشجرتين» is Suwayd's variant note, not a link
